```
// Define the function to adapt CoinbaseProOrder status to OrderStatus
FUNCTION adaptOrderStatus(order: CoinbaseProOrder) RETURNS OrderStatus

    // Check if the order status is pending
    IF order.getStatus().equals("pending") THEN
        RETURN OrderStatus.PENDING_NEW

    // Check if the order status is done or settled
    IF order.getStatus().equals("done") OR order.getStatus().equals("settled") THEN

        // Check the reason for the order being done
        IF order.getDoneReason().equals("filled") THEN
            RETURN OrderStatus.FILLED
        
        IF order.getDoneReason().equals("canceled") THEN
            RETURN OrderStatus.CANCELED
        
        RETURN OrderStatus.UNKNOWN

    // Check if the filled size of the order is zero
    IF order.getFilledSize().signum() == 0 THEN

        // Check if the order status is open and has a stop condition
        IF order.getStatus().equals("open") AND order.getStop() != null THEN
            RETURN OrderStatus.STOPPED
        
        RETURN OrderStatus.NEW

    // Check if the order is partially filled
    IF order.getFilledSize().compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) > 0 AND 
       order.getSize().compareTo(order.getFilledSize()) >= 0 THEN
        RETURN OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED

    // Default case for unknown order status
    RETURN OrderStatus.UNKNOWN
```

docstring:
Given a set of m probabilities, draw with replacement a set of n random
number in [0, m).
@param prob probabilities of size n. The prob argument can be used to
give a vector of weights for obtaining the elements of the vector being
sampled. They need not sum to one, but they should be nonnegative and
not all zero.
@return an random array of length n in range of [0, m).
pseudo_code:
```
// FUNCTION to generate an array of random indices based on input probabilities
FUNCTION random(probabilities: double[], sampleSize: int) -> int[]:

    // Initialize an array to hold scaled probabilities
    DECLARE scaledProbabilities AS double[] WITH SIZE equal to LENGTH of probabilities

    // Scale the input probabilities by the length of the probabilities array
    FOR each index i FROM 0 TO LENGTH of probabilities - 1:
        scaledProbabilities[i] = probabilities[i] * LENGTH of probabilities

    // Initialize an array to hold indices
    DECLARE indices AS int[] WITH SIZE equal to LENGTH of probabilities

    // Fill the indices array with sequential indices
    FOR each index i FROM 0 TO LENGTH of probabilities - 1:
        indices[i] = i

    // Initialize an array for high and low indices
    DECLARE HL AS int[] WITH SIZE equal to LENGTH of probabilities
    DECLARE head AS int = 0
    DECLARE tail AS int = LENGTH of probabilities - 1

    // Classify indices into high and low based on their scaled probabilities
    FOR each index i FROM 0 TO LENGTH of probabilities - 1:
        IF scaledProbabilities[i] >= 1.0 THEN:
            HL[head] = i
            head = head + 1
        ELSE:
            HL[tail] = i
            tail = tail - 1

    // Construct the alias table
    WHILE head != 0 AND tail != LENGTH of probabilities - 1:
        DECLARE lowIndex AS int = HL[tail + 1]
        DECLARE highIndex AS int = HL[head - 1]
        
        indices[lowIndex] = highIndex
        scaledProbabilities[highIndex] = scaledProbabilities[highIndex] + scaledProbabilities[lowIndex] - 1
        
        tail = tail + 1  // Remove lowIndex from low group
        IF scaledProbabilities[highIndex] < 1.0 THEN:
            HL[tail] = highIndex  // Add highIndex to low group
            head = head - 1       // Remove highIndex from high group

    // Generate the random sample
    DECLARE result AS int[] WITH SIZE equal to sampleSize
    FOR each index i FROM 0 TO sampleSize - 1:
        DECLARE randomValue AS double = random() * LENGTH of probabilities
        
        DECLARE k AS int = CAST randomValue TO int
        randomValue = randomValue - k  // Adjust randomValue to be fractional part

        IF randomValue < scaledProbabilities[k] THEN:
            result[i] = k
        ELSE:
            result[i] = indices[k]

    // RETURN the generated random sample
    RETURN result
```

docstring:
Each message will be written to one or more outputs.

The default output is always being used for every message, but optionally the message can be routed to additional outputs, currently based on the stream outputs that are configured in the system.

The stream outputs are time limited so one bad output does not impact throughput too much. Essentially this means that the work of writing to the outputs is performed, but the writer threads will not wait forever for stream outputs to finish their work. This might lead to increased memory usage!

The default output, however, is allowed to block and is not subject to time limiting. This is important because it can exert back pressure on the processing pipeline this way, making sure we don't run into excessive heap usage.

@param event the message to write to outputs @throws Exception
pseudo_code:
```
// Pseudo-code for processing messages and writing to outputs

FUNCTION onEvent(event) // Accepts a MessageEvent as input
    // Mark incoming messages for tracking
    incomingMessages.mark()

    // Extract the message from the event
    SET msg = event.getMessage()
    IF msg IS NULL THEN
        LOG.debug("Skipping null message.") // Log debug message
        RETURN // Exit if the message is null
    END IF
    LOG.debug("Processing message <{}> from OutputBuffer.", msg.getId()) // Log message processing start

    // Get the set of message outputs based on the message
    SET messageOutputs = outputRouter.getStreamOutputsForMessage(msg)
    msg.recordCounter(serverStatus, "matched-outputs", messageOutputs.size()) // Record matched outputs count

    // Process the default output and get its completion future
    SET defaultOutputCompletion = processMessage(msg, defaultMessageOutput)

    // Create a countdown latch for stream outputs
    SET streamOutputsDoneSignal = new CountDownLatch(messageOutputs.size())
    FOR EACH output IN messageOutputs DO
        processMessage(msg, output, streamOutputsDoneSignal) // Process each stream output
    END FOR

    // Wait for all stream output writer threads to finish or timeout
    IF NOT streamOutputsDoneSignal.await(configuration.getOutputModuleTimeout(), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) THEN
        LOG.warn("Timeout reached. Not waiting any longer for stream output writer threads to complete.") // Log warning
    END IF

    // Block until the default output has finished processing
    IF defaultOutputCompletion IS NOT NULL THEN
        Uninterruptibles.getUninterruptibly(defaultOutputCompletion) // Wait for default output completion
    ELSE
        LOG.error("The default output future was null, this is a bug!") // Log error if null
    END IF

    // Log message recordings if they exist
    IF msg.hasRecordings() THEN
        LOG.debug("Message event trace: {}", msg.recordingsAsString()) // Log message recordings
    END IF

    outputThroughput.inc() // Increment output throughput counter

    LOG.debug("Wrote message <{}> to all outputs. Finished handling.", msg.getId()) // Log completion

    event.clearMessages() // Clear messages from the event
END FUNCTION
```

```
// Function to return the formal type parameters of a given type
FUNCTION formalTypeParametersString(type: TypeElement) RETURNS String
    // Get the list of type parameters from the provided type
    typeParameters: List<? extends TypeParameterElement> = type.getTypeParameters()
    
    // Check if there are no type parameters
    IF typeParameters.isEmpty() THEN
        RETURN "" // Return an empty string if no type parameters exist
    ELSE
        // Initialize a StringBuilder to construct the output string
        sb: StringBuilder = new StringBuilder("<")
        sep: String = "" // Separator for type parameters
        
        // Iterate through each type parameter
        FOR each typeParameter IN typeParameters DO
            sb.append(sep) // Append the separator
            sep = ", " // Update separator for subsequent parameters
            
            // Append the type parameter with its bounds to the StringBuilder
            appendTypeParameterWithBounds(typeParameter, sb)
        END FOR
        
        // Append closing bracket and return the constructed string
        RETURN sb.append(">").toString()
    END IF
```

pseudo_code:
```
// Function to copy a file using a script
FUNCTION copyFile(
    INPUT ExecutionContext executionContext, // Execution context for operations
    INPUT File file, // Source file to be copied
    INPUT InputStream input, // Input stream for content
    INPUT String content, // Content to be copied
    INPUT INodeEntry node, // Node entry containing attributes
    INPUT String remotePath // Destination path for remote copy
) RETURNS String // Returns the path of the copied file or throws an exception
    // Initialize variables
    DECLARE File workingdir AS NULL
    DECLARE String scriptargs
    DECLARE String dirstring

    // Get the framework from execution context
    DECLARE Framework framework AS executionContext.getFramework()

    // Retrieve script execution arguments
    scriptargs = framework.getProjectProperty(executionContext.getFrameworkProject(), SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_COMMAND_PROPERTY)

    // Check for specific script attribute in node
    IF node.getAttributes().get(SCRIPT_ATTRIBUTE) IS NOT NULL THEN
        scriptargs = node.getAttributes().get(SCRIPT_ATTRIBUTE)
    ENDIF

    // Validate script arguments
    IF scriptargs IS NULL THEN
        THROW FileCopierException("No attribute found on node and no property configured", ConfigurationFailure)
    ENDIF

    // Get the default directory for script execution
    dirstring = framework.getProjectProperty(executionContext.getFrameworkProject(), SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_DIR_PROPERTY)

    // Check for directory attribute in node
    IF node.getAttributes().get(DIR_ATTRIBUTE) IS NOT NULL THEN
        dirstring = node.getAttributes().get(DIR_ATTRIBUTE)
    ENDIF

    // Set working directory if specified
    IF dirstring IS NOT NULL AND dirstring IS NOT EMPTY THEN
        workingdir = NEW File(dirstring)
    ENDIF

    // Determine source file
    DECLARE File srcFile AS (file IS NOT NULL ? file : BaseFileCopier.writeTempFile(executionContext, file, input, content))

    // Create context data with node attributes
    DECLARE Map<String, Map<String, String>> newDataContext
    DECLARE Map<String, Map<String, String>> nodeContext AS DataContextUtils.addContext("node", DataContextUtils.nodeData(node), executionContext.getDataContext())

    // Prepare execution context for script
    DECLARE HashMap<String, String> scptexec AS NEW HashMap()
    scptexec.put("filename", srcFile.getName())
    scptexec.put("destfilename", srcFile.getName())
    scptexec.put("file", srcFile.getAbsolutePath())

    // Adjust destination filename if remotePath is provided
    IF remotePath IS NOT NULL AND NOT remotePath.endsWith("/") THEN
        scptexec.put("destfilename", NEW File(remotePath).getName())
    ENDIF

    // Add working directory to execution context if specified
    IF workingdir IS NOT NULL THEN
        scptexec.put("dir", workingdir.getAbsolutePath())
    ENDIF

    // Add file-copy context to new data context
    newDataContext = DataContextUtils.addContext("file-copy", scptexec, nodeContext)

    // Expand remote filepath if not specified
    DECLARE String copiedFilepath
    IF remotePath IS NULL THEN
        copiedFilepath = framework.getProjectProperty(executionContext.getFrameworkProject(), SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_REMOTE_FILEPATH_PROPERTY)
        
        IF node.getAttributes().get(REMOTE_FILEPATH_ATTRIBUTE) IS NOT NULL THEN
            copiedFilepath = node.getAttributes().get(REMOTE_FILEPATH_ATTRIBUTE)
        ENDIF

        // Ensure copiedFilepath is formatted correctly
        IF copiedFilepath IS NOT NULL THEN
            IF NOT (copiedFilepath.contains("${file-copy.filename}") OR copiedFilepath.contains("${file-copy.file}")) AND NOT copiedFilepath.endsWith("/") THEN
                copiedFilepath += "/"
            ENDIF
            copiedFilepath = DataContextUtils.replaceDataReferencesInString(copiedFilepath, newDataContext)
        ENDIF
    ELSE
        // Use specific destination path
        copiedFilepath = remotePath
    ENDIF

    // Append filename to copiedFilepath if necessary
    IF copiedFilepath IS NOT NULL AND copiedFilepath.endsWith("/") THEN
        copiedFilepath += srcFile.getName()
    ENDIF

    // Set destination in execution context
    scptexec.put("destination", (copiedFilepath IS NOT NULL ? copiedFilepath : ""))

    // Add updated file-copy context
    newDataContext = DataContextUtils.addContext("file-copy", scptexec, nodeContext)

    // Retrieve remote shell command
    DECLARE String remoteShell AS framework.getProjectProperty(executionContext.getFrameworkProject(), SCRIPT_COPY_DEFAULT_REMOTE_SHELL)
    IF node.getAttributes().get(SHELL_ATTRIBUTE) IS NOT NULL THEN
        remoteShell = node.getAttributes().get(SHELL_ATTRIBUTE)
    ENDIF

    // Execute the script process
    DECLARE Process exec
    TRY
        IF remoteShell IS NOT NULL THEN
            exec = ScriptUtil.execShellProcess(executionContext.getExecutionListener(), workingdir, scriptargs, nodeContext, newDataContext, remoteShell, "script-copy")
        ELSE
            exec = ScriptUtil.execProcess(executionContext.getExecutionListener(), workingdir, scriptargs, nodeContext, newDataContext, "script-copy")
        ENDIF
    CATCH IOException e THEN
        THROW FileCopierException(e.getMessage(), IOFailure, e)
    FINALLY
        // Release temporary file if applicable
        IF file IS NULL THEN
            IF NOT ScriptfileUtils.releaseTempFile(srcFile) THEN
                executionContext.getExecutionListener().log(Constants.WARN_LEVEL, "Unable to remove local temp file")
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDTRY

    // Prepare to capture output and error streams
    DECLARE Thread errthread
    DECLARE Thread outthread AS NULL
    DECLARE int result
    DECLARE boolean success
    DECLARE ByteArrayOutputStream byteArrayOutputStream AS NEW ByteArrayOutputStream()

    TRY
        exec.getOutputStream().close()
        errthread = Streams.copyStreamThread(exec.getErrorStream(), System.err)
        IF copiedFilepath IS NULL THEN
            outthread = Streams.copyStreamThread(exec.getInputStream(), byteArrayOutputStream)
        ENDIF
        errthread.start()
        IF outthread IS NOT NULL THEN
            outthread.start()
        ENDIF
        result = exec.waitFor()
        System.err.flush()
        byteArrayOutputStream.flush()
        errthread.join()
        IF outthread IS NOT NULL THEN
            outthread.join()
        ENDIF
        exec.getErrorStream().close()
        exec.getInputStream().close()
        success = (result == 0)
    CATCH InterruptedException e THEN
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
        THROW FileCopierException(e.getMessage(), Interrupted, e)
    CATCH IOException e THEN
        THROW FileCopierException(e.getMessage(), IOFailure, e)
    ENDTRY

    // Check the success of the execution
    IF NOT success THEN
        IF scriptargs.contains("${file-copy.destination}") AND copiedFilepath IS NULL THEN
            executionContext.getExecutionListener().log(0, "[script-copy]: destination not determined")
        ENDIF
        THROW FileCopierException("[script-copy]: external script failed with exit code: " + result, NonZeroResultCode)
    ENDIF

    // Handle the output and return the result
    IF copiedFilepath IS NOT NULL THEN
        RETURN copiedFilepath
    ENDIF

    // Load output from outputstream
    DECLARE String output AS byteArrayOutputStream.toString()
    IF output IS NULL OR output.length() < 1 THEN
        THROW FileCopierException("[script-copy]: No output from external script", ScriptFileCopierPluginExpectedOutputMissing)
    ENDIF

    // Check for valid output
    DECLARE String[] split1 AS output.split("(\\r?\\n)")
    IF split1.length < 1 THEN
        THROW FileCopierException("[script-copy]: No output from external script", ScriptFileCopierPluginExpectedOutputMissing)
    ENDIF

    DECLARE String remotefilepath AS split1[0]
    executionContext.getExecutionListener().log(3, "[script-copy]: result filepath: " + remotefilepath)

    RETURN remotefilepath // Return the path of the copied file
END FUNCTION
```

Returns the number of microseconds since the epoch (00:00:00, 01-Jan-1970, GMT). The precision of the
returned value may vary depending on {@linkplain #javaVersion() Java version}. Currently, Java 9 or
above is required for microsecond precision. {@code System.currentTimeMillis() * 1000} is returned on
Java 8.
pseudo_code:
```
// Function to return the number of microseconds since the epoch
FUNCTION currentTimeMicros() RETURNS long

    // Check the Java version
    IF javaVersion() == 8 THEN
        // Return microseconds from current time in milliseconds
        RETURN TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toMicros(System.currentTimeMillis())
    ELSE
        // Java 9 or above: Get current time with higher precision
        DECLARE now AS Instant
        now = Clock.systemUTC().instant()
        
        // Calculate total microseconds from seconds and nanoseconds
        RETURN TimeUnit.SECONDS.toMicros(now.getEpochSecond()) + 
               TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMicros(now.getNano())
    END IF

END FUNCTION
```

```
// Function to handle header value parsing
FUNCTION handleHeaderValue(buffer, state, builder) 
    // Initialize StringBuilder from state or create a new one
    IF state.stringBuilder IS NULL THEN
        stringBuilder = NEW StringBuilder()
        state.parseState = 0
    ELSE
        stringBuilder = state.stringBuilder
    ENDIF

    // Set initial parse state
    parseState = state.parseState

    // Loop while there are remaining bytes in the buffer
    WHILE buffer.hasRemaining() DO
        next = buffer.get() // Get the next byte

        // Switch based on the current parse state
        SWITCH parseState DO
            CASE NORMAL:
                IF next == '\r' THEN
                    parseState = BEGIN_LINE_END
                ELSE IF next == '\n' THEN
                    parseState = LINE_END
                ELSE IF next == ' ' OR next == '\t' THEN
                    parseState = WHITESPACE
                ELSE
                    stringBuilder.append((char) next) // Append character to stringBuilder
                ENDIF
                BREAK

            CASE WHITESPACE:
                IF next == '\r' THEN
                    parseState = BEGIN_LINE_END
                ELSE IF next == '\n' THEN
                    parseState = LINE_END
                ELSE IF next != ' ' AND next != '\t' THEN
                    IF stringBuilder.length() > 0 THEN
                        stringBuilder.append(' ') // Add space if stringBuilder is not empty
                    ENDIF
                    stringBuilder.append((char) next) // Append character to stringBuilder
                    parseState = NORMAL
                ENDIF
                BREAK

            CASE LINE_END:
            CASE BEGIN_LINE_END:
                IF next == '\n' AND parseState == BEGIN_LINE_END THEN
                    parseState = LINE_END
                ELSE IF next == '\t' OR next == ' ' THEN
                    parseState = WHITESPACE // Continuation
                ELSE
                    // Handle header
                    nextStandardHeader = state.nextHeader
                    headerValue = stringBuilder.toString() // Get header value

                    // TODO: Decode according to RFC-2047 if needed

                    builder.getResponseHeaders().add(nextStandardHeader, headerValue) // Add header to builder
                    state.nextHeader = NULL
                    state.leftOver = next
                    stringBuilder.setLength(0) // Clear stringBuilder

                    IF next == '\r' THEN
                        parseState = AWAIT_DATA_END
                    ELSE
                        state.state = ResponseParseState.HEADER
                        state.parseState = 0
                        RETURN // Finish processing
                    ENDIF
                ENDIF
                BREAK

            CASE AWAIT_DATA_END:
                state.state = ResponseParseState.PARSE_COMPLETE
                RETURN // Finish processing
        ENDSWITCH
    ENDWHILE

    // Update parse state if parsing is incomplete
    state.parseState = parseState
END FUNCTION
```

```
FUNCTION checkTouchSlop(directions: Integer, pointerId: Integer) RETURNS Boolean
    // Check if the specified pointer is currently down
    IF NOT isPointerDown(pointerId) THEN
        RETURN false
    END IF

    // Determine if horizontal or vertical checks are needed
    SET checkHorizontal = (directions AND DIRECTION_HORIZONTAL) EQUALS DIRECTION_HORIZONTAL
    SET checkVertical = (directions AND DIRECTION_VERTICAL) EQUALS DIRECTION_VERTICAL

    // Calculate the change in motion coordinates
    SET dx = mLastMotionX[pointerId] - mInitialMotionX[pointerId]
    SET dy = mLastMotionY[pointerId] - mInitialMotionY[pointerId]

    // Check if both horizontal and vertical slop thresholds are crossed
    IF checkHorizontal AND checkVertical THEN
        RETURN (dx * dx + dy * dy) > (mTouchSlop * mTouchSlop)
    ELSE IF checkHorizontal THEN
        RETURN ABS(dx) > mTouchSlop
    ELSE IF checkVertical THEN
        RETURN ABS(dy) > mTouchSlop
    END IF

    // Return false if no slop threshold is crossed
    RETURN false
```

```
// Function to extract a quoted value from a header based on a given key
FUNCTION extractQuotedValueFromHeader(header: String, key: String) RETURNS String

    // Initialize key position and starting position for value extraction
    SET keypos = 0
    SET pos = -1
    SET whiteSpace = true
    SET inQuotes = false
    
    // Iterate through each character in the header
    FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH(header) - 2 DO // -2 because we need room for the '=' at the end
        SET c = header.charAt(i)

        // Check if currently inside quotes
        IF inQuotes THEN
            // If character is a closing quote
            IF c == '"' THEN
                SET inQuotes = false
            ENDIF
        ELSE
            // Match the key character with the current character
            IF key.charAt(keypos) == c AND (whiteSpace OR keypos > 0) THEN
                INCREMENT keypos
                SET whiteSpace = false
            ELSE IF c == '"' THEN
                // Start of a quoted value
                SET keypos = 0
                SET inQuotes = true
                SET whiteSpace = false
            ELSE
                // Reset key position if no match
                SET keypos = 0
                SET whiteSpace = (c == ' ' OR c == ';' OR c == '\t')
            ENDIF
            
            // Check if the entire key has been matched
            IF keypos == LENGTH(key) THEN
                // Check for '=' following the key
                IF header.charAt(i + 1) == '=' THEN
                    SET pos = i + 2 // Position after '='
                    BREAK // Exit the loop as we found the key
                ELSE
                    SET keypos = 0 // Reset key position if '=' not found
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR

    // If the position for the value was not found, return null
    IF pos == -1 THEN
        RETURN null
    ENDIF

    // Extract the value starting from the found position
    SET start = pos

    // Check if the value is quoted
    IF header.charAt(start) == '"' THEN
        INCREMENT start // Move past the opening quote
        FOR end FROM start TO LENGTH(header) DO
            SET c = header.charAt(end)
            // Break on closing quote
            IF c == '"' THEN
                BREAK
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        RETURN header.substring(start, end) // Return the quoted value
    ELSE
        // If not quoted, extract until whitespace or delimiter
        FOR end FROM start TO LENGTH(header) DO
            SET c = header.charAt(end)
            // Break on whitespace or delimiter
            IF c == ' ' OR c == '\t' OR c == ';' THEN
                BREAK
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        RETURN header.substring(start, end) // Return the unquoted value
    ENDIF
END FUNCTION
```

```
// Function to resolve the fully qualified name of a superclass based on simple class name, package descriptor, and package registry
FUNCTION resolveType(STRING klass, PackageDescr packageDescr, PackageRegistry pkgRegistry) RETURNS STRING

    STRING arraySuffix = "" // Initialize variable to hold array suffix
    INTEGER arrayIndex = klass.indexOf("[") // Find index of array notation
    IF arrayIndex >= 0 THEN
        arraySuffix = klass.substring(arrayIndex) // Extract array suffix
        klass = klass.substring(0, arrayIndex) // Update klass to remove array notation
    ENDIF

    // Look among imports for fully qualified class names
    STRING temp = klass // Temporary variable to hold current class name
    WHILE temp.length() > 0 DO
        FOR EACH ImportDescr id IN packageDescr.getImports() DO
            STRING fqKlass = id.getTarget() // Get fully qualified class name from import
            IF fqKlass.endsWith("." + temp) THEN
                // Construct fully qualified name
                fqKlass = fqKlass.substring(0, fqKlass.lastIndexOf(temp)) + klass
                RETURN arrayIndex < 0 ? fqKlass : fqKlass + arraySuffix // Return resolved class name with suffix if applicable
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        temp = temp.substring(0, Math.max(0, temp.lastIndexOf('.'))) // Update temp to check for parent class names
    ENDWHILE

    // Look among local declarations if packageRegistry is not null
    IF pkgRegistry IS NOT NULL THEN
        FOR EACH declaredName IN pkgRegistry.getPackage().getTypeDeclarations().keySet() DO
            IF declaredName.equals(klass) THEN
                TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = pkgRegistry.getPackage().getTypeDeclaration(declaredName) // Get type declaration
                IF typeDeclaration.getTypeClass() IS NOT NULL THEN
                    klass = typeDeclaration.getTypeClass().getName() // Update klass with the type class name
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDIF

    // Check local declarations in the package descriptor
    IF klass IS NOT NULL AND NOT klass.contains(".") AND packageDescr.getNamespace() IS NOT NULL AND !packageDescr.getNamespace().isEmpty() THEN
        FOR EACH AbstractClassTypeDeclarationDescr td IN packageDescr.getClassAndEnumDeclarationDescrs() DO
            IF klass.equals(td.getTypeName()) THEN
                IF td.getType().getFullName().contains(".") THEN
                    klass = td.getType().getFullName() // Update klass with the full name
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDIF

    RETURN arrayIndex < 0 ? klass : klass + arraySuffix // Return the final resolved class name with suffix if applicable
END FUNCTION
```

```
// This function decodes a number from a JSON value and returns a number or a String if invalid.
// @param minus indicates whether the number is negative
// @return a number or a String if not valid

FUNCTION decodeNumberLax(boolean minus) 
    // Initialize variables
    char[] array = charArray
    int startIndex = __index
    int index = __index
    char currentChar
    boolean doubleFloat = false
    boolean foundDot = false
    boolean foundSign = false
    boolean foundExp = false

    // Adjust index if number is negative
    IF minus AND index + 1 < array.length THEN
        index = index + 1
    END IF

    // Loop through characters in the array
    WHILE TRUE DO
        currentChar = array[index]
        
        // Check if current character is a digit
        IF isNumberDigit(currentChar) THEN
            // Do nothing, valid digit
        ELSE IF currentChar <= 32 THEN // Check for whitespace
            BREAK
        ELSE IF isDelimiter(currentChar) THEN
            BREAK
        ELSE IF isDecimalChar(currentChar) THEN
            // Handle decimal point, exponent, and sign
            SWITCH currentChar DO
                CASE DECIMAL_POINT:
                    IF foundDot OR foundExp THEN 
                        RETURN decodeStringLax() 
                    END IF
                    foundDot = TRUE
                CASE LETTER_E:
                CASE LETTER_BIG_E:
                    IF foundExp THEN 
                        RETURN decodeStringLax() 
                    END IF
                    foundExp = TRUE
                CASE MINUS:
                CASE PLUS:
                    IF foundSign OR NOT foundExp THEN 
                        RETURN decodeStringLax() 
                    END IF
                    IF foundExp AND array[index - 1] NOT IN [LETTER_E, LETTER_BIG_E] THEN 
                        RETURN decodeStringLax() 
                    END IF
                    foundSign = TRUE
            END SWITCH
            doubleFloat = TRUE
        ELSE 
            RETURN decodeStringLax() 
        END IF
        
        index = index + 1
        
        // Exit loop if index exceeds array length
        IF index >= array.length THEN 
            BREAK 
        END IF
    END WHILE

    // Handle case where exponent ends without actual exponent
    IF foundExp THEN
        char prevChar = array[index - 1]
        IF prevChar IN [LETTER_E, LETTER_BIG_E, MINUS, PLUS] THEN
            RETURN decodeStringLax()
        END IF
    END IF

    // Update the index and current character
    __index = index
    __currentChar = currentChar

    // Determine the type of number
    Type type = doubleFloat ? Type.DOUBLE : Type.INTEGER

    // Return the number value
    RETURN new NumberValue(chop, type, startIndex, __index, this.charArray)
END FUNCTION
```

This method will group all puts per partition and send a {@link com.hazelcast.map.impl.operation.PutAllPartitionAwareOperationFactory} per member.

If there are e.g. five keys for a single member, there will only be a single remote invocation instead of having five remote invocations.

There is also an optional support for batching to send smaller packages. Takes care about {@code null} checks for keys and values.
pseudo_code:
```
// Function to group and send puts per partition
FUNCTION putAllInternal(map: Map<?, ?>) 
    // Get the size of the input map
    mapSize = map.size()
    // Check if the map is empty
    IF mapSize == 0 THEN 
        RETURN
    END IF

    // Determine if batching is required based on map size
    useBatching = isPutAllUseBatching(mapSize)
    // Get the total number of partitions
    partitionCount = partitionService.getPartitionCount()
    // Calculate the initial size for batching
    initialSize = getPutAllInitialSize(useBatching, mapSize, partitionCount)

    // Get the mapping of members to their partitions
    memberPartitionsMap = partitionService.getMemberPartitionsMap()

    // Initialize counters for batching if needed
    IF useBatching THEN 
        counterPerMember = Array of MutableLong[partitionCount]
        addresses = Array of Address[partitionCount]
        // Populate the counters and addresses for each partition
        FOR each addressListEntry IN memberPartitionsMap.entrySet() 
            counter = new MutableLong()
            address = addressListEntry.getKey()
            FOR each partitionId IN addressListEntry.getValue() 
                counterPerMember[partitionId] = counter
                addresses[partitionId] = address
            END FOR
        END FOR
    END IF

    // Prepare entries per partition
    entriesPerPartition = Array of MapEntries[partitionCount]
    // Process each entry in the input map
    FOR each entry IN map.entrySet() 
        // Validate key and value are not null
        checkNotNull(entry.getKey(), NULL_KEY_IS_NOT_ALLOWED)
        checkNotNull(entry.getValue(), NULL_VALUE_IS_NOT_ALLOWED)

        // Convert key to data format
        keyData = toDataWithStrategy(entry.getKey())
        // Determine the partition id for the key
        partitionId = partitionService.getPartitionId(keyData)
        // Get or create entries for the partition
        entries = entriesPerPartition[partitionId]
        IF entries IS NULL THEN 
            entries = new MapEntries(initialSize)
            entriesPerPartition[partitionId] = entries
        END IF

        // Add the key-value pair to the entries
        entries.add(keyData, toData(entry.getValue()))

        // If batching is enabled, check if batch size is reached
        IF useBatching THEN 
            currentSize = ++counterPerMember[partitionId].value
            IF currentSize % putAllBatchSize == 0 THEN 
                partitions = memberPartitionsMap.get(addresses[partitionId])
                // Invoke the put operation for the current batch
                invokePutAllOperation(partitions, entriesPerPartition)
            END IF
        END IF
    END FOR

    // Final invocation for remaining entries in each partition
    FOR each entry IN memberPartitionsMap.entrySet() 
        invokePutAllOperation(entry.getValue(), entriesPerPartition)
    END FOR

    // Finalize the put operation
    finalizePutAll(map)
EXCEPTION 
    // Handle exceptions by rethrowing
    THROW rethrow(e)
END FUNCTION
```

This determines which clusters all data that are rooted node will be
assigned to, and updates sums, counts and membership (if not null)
accordingly. Candidates maintains the set of cluster indices which
could possibly be the closest clusters for data in this subtree.
pseudo_code:
```
// Function to filter and assign clusters based on node data
FUNCTION filter(Node node, double[][] centroids, int[] candidates, int k, double[][] sums, int[] counts, int[] membership) RETURNS double
    // Get the dimensionality of the centroid data
    int d = centroids[0].length

    // Initialize minimum distance and closest cluster
    double minDist = Math.squaredDistance(node.center, centroids[candidates[0]])
    int closest = candidates[0]

    // Loop through candidates to find the closest centroid
    FOR i FROM 1 TO k-1 DO
        double dist = Math.squaredDistance(node.center, centroids[candidates[i]])
        IF dist < minDist THEN
            minDist = dist
            closest = candidates[i]
        ENDIF
    END FOR

    // Check if the current node is not a leaf node
    IF node.lower IS NOT NULL THEN
        // Initialize a new list of candidates
        int[] newCandidates = new int[k]
        int newk = 0

        // Build the new list of candidates
        FOR i FROM 0 TO k-1 DO
            IF NOT prune(node.center, node.radius, centroids, closest, candidates[i]) THEN
                newCandidates[newk] = candidates[i]
                newk = newk + 1
            ENDIF
        END FOR

        // Recurse if there are at least two candidates
        IF newk > 1 THEN
            double result = filter(node.lower, centroids, newCandidates, newk, sums, counts, membership) + filter(node.upper, centroids, newCandidates, newk, sums, counts, membership)
            RETURN result
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

    // Assign sums and counts to the closest cluster
    FOR i FROM 0 TO d-1 DO
        sums[closest][i] += node.sum[i]
    END FOR

    counts[closest] += node.count

    // Update membership if it is not null
    IF membership IS NOT NULL THEN
        int last = node.index + node.count
        FOR i FROM node.index TO last-1 DO
            membership[index[i]] = closest
        END FOR
    ENDIF

    // Return the cost associated with the current node
    RETURN getNodeCost(node, centroids[closest])
END FUNCTION
```

```
// Function to get a parser for a given MIME type
FUNCTION getParserForMIMEType(mimeType: String) RETURNS ResourceFormatParser THROWS UnsupportedFormatException

    // Clean up the encoding from the MIME type
    IF mimeType is not null AND mimeType contains ";" THEN
        cleanMime = substring(mimeType, 0, indexOf(mimeType, ";"))
    ELSE
        cleanMime = mimeType
    END IF

    // Validate the cleaned MIME type
    IF NOT validMimeType(cleanMime) THEN
        THROW IllegalArgumentException("Invalid MIME type: " + mimeType)
    END IF

    // Iterate through the list of resource format parsers
    FOR each resourceFormatParser IN listParsers() DO
        // Check if the parser has MIME types
        IF resourceFormatParser.getMIMETypes() is not null THEN
            // Check if the cleaned MIME type matches any of the parser's MIME types
            IF resourceFormatParser.getMIMETypes().contains(cleanMime) THEN
                RETURN resourceFormatParser
            ELSE
                // Check for wildcard MIME type match
                FOR each s IN resourceFormatParser.getMIMETypes() DO
                    IF validMimeType(s) AND s starts with "*/" THEN
                        t1 = substring(s, 2)
                        t2 = substring(cleanMime, indexOf(cleanMime, "/") + 1)
                        IF t1 equals t2 THEN
                            RETURN resourceFormatParser
                        END IF
                    END IF
                END FOR
            END IF
        END IF
    END FOR

    // No matching parser found, throw exception
    THROW UnsupportedFormatException("No provider available to parse MIME type: " + mimeType)
END FUNCTION
```

```
FUNCTION migrate(service: CRDTReplicationAwareService, target: Member, maxConfiguredReplicaCount: Integer) RETURNS Boolean
    // Check if the current thread is interrupted
    IF Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() THEN
        RETURN false

    // Get the operation service from the node engine
    DECLARE operationService AS OperationService
    operationService = nodeEngine.getOperationService()

    // Prepare the migration operation for the service
    DECLARE migrationOperation AS CRDTReplicationContainer
    migrationOperation = service.prepareMigrationOperation(maxConfiguredReplicaCount)

    // Check if migration operation is null
    IF migrationOperation IS NULL THEN
        // Log and skip migration
        logger.finest("Skipping migration of " + service.getName() + " for target " + target)
        RETURN true

    // Log the start of migration
    logger.finest("Migrating " + service.getName() + " to " + target)

    // Invoke the migration operation on the target
    operationService.invokeOnTarget(null, migrationOperation.getOperation(), target.getAddress()).join()

    // Clear the CRDT state after migration
    DECLARE allMigrated AS Boolean
    allMigrated = service.clearCRDTState(migrationOperation.getVectorClocks())

    // Check if all CRDTs were migrated successfully
    IF NOT allMigrated THEN
        logger.fine(service.getName() + " CRDTs have been mutated since migrated to target " + target
                + ". Rescheduling migration in " + MIGRATION_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS + " second(s).")
    ENDIF

    RETURN allMigrated

    // Exception handling is implicit in the flow
    // Log failure and reschedule migration
    CATCH Exception e
        IF logger.isFineEnabled() THEN
            logger.fine("Failed migration of " + service.getName() + " for target " + target
                    + ". Rescheduling migration in " + MIGRATION_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS + " second(s).", e)
        ELSE
            logger.info("Failed migration of " + service.getName() + " for target " + target
                    + ". Rescheduling migration in " + MIGRATION_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS + " second(s).")
```

```
                        result = NumberMath.xor(leftNumber, rightNumber)
                    CASE POWER:
                        result = DefaultGroovyMethods.power(leftNumber, rightNumber)
                ENDSWITCH

                // Check if result is not null and return the corresponding constant expression
                IF result != null THEN 
                    IF ClassHelper.Byte_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN 
                        RETURN configure(binaryExpression, new ConstantExpression(result.byteValue(), true))
                    ELSE IF ClassHelper.Short_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN 
                        RETURN configure(binaryExpression, new ConstantExpression(result.shortValue(), true))
                    ELSE IF ClassHelper.Long_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN 
                        RETURN configure(binaryExpression, new ConstantExpression(result.longValue(), true))
                    ELSE IF ClassHelper.Integer_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) OR ClassHelper.Character_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN 
                        RETURN configure(binaryExpression, new ConstantExpression(result.intValue(), true))
                    ELSE IF ClassHelper.Float_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN 
                        RETURN configure(binaryExpression, new ConstantExpression(result.floatValue(), true))
                    ELSE IF ClassHelper.Double_TYPE.equals(wrapperType) THEN 
                        RETURN configure(binaryExpression, new ConstantExpression(result.doubleValue(), true))
                    ELSE 
                        RETURN configure(binaryExpression, new ConstantExpression(result, true))
                    ENDIF
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

    // Return null if no transformation was performed
    RETURN null
END FUNCTION
```

```
// Function to get a new value from the pool
FUNCTION get(size: Integer) RETURNS V

    // Ensure the pool size invariant is maintained
    ensurePoolSizeInvariant()

    // Get the bucketed size based on the requested size
    bucketedSize = getBucketedSize(size)
    sizeInBytes = -1

    // Synchronize access to the pool
    SYNCHRONIZED(this) DO

        // Retrieve the appropriate bucket for the bucketed size
        bucket = getBucket(bucketedSize)

        // Check if the bucket exists
        IF bucket IS NOT NULL THEN
            // Attempt to find an existing value that can be reused
            value = getValue(bucket)
            IF value IS NOT NULL THEN
                // Add the value to the in-use collection
                Preconditions.checkState(mInUseValues.add(value))

                // Recompute the size in bytes for the reused value
                bucketedSize = getBucketedSizeForValue(value)
                sizeInBytes = getSizeInBytes(bucketedSize)
                mUsed.increment(sizeInBytes)
                mFree.decrement(sizeInBytes)
                mPoolStatsTracker.onValueReuse(sizeInBytes)
                logStats()
                
                // Log verbose information about the reused value
                IF FLog.isLoggable(FLog.VERBOSE) THEN
                    FLog.v(TAG, "get (reuse) (object, size) = (%x, %s)", System.identityHashCode(value), bucketedSize)
                END IF
                
                RETURN value // Return the reused value
            END IF
        END IF

        // Check if we can allocate a value of the given size without exceeding the hard cap
        sizeInBytes = getSizeInBytes(bucketedSize)
        IF NOT canAllocate(sizeInBytes) THEN
            THROW PoolSizeViolationException(mPoolParams.maxSizeHardCap, mUsed.mNumBytes, mFree.mNumBytes, sizeInBytes)
        END IF

        // Assume allocation will succeed
        mUsed.increment(sizeInBytes)
        IF bucket IS NOT NULL THEN
            bucket.incrementInUseCount()
        END IF
    END SYNCHRONIZED

    // Variable for the new value
    value = NULL
    TRY
        // Allocate the value outside of the synchronized block
        value = alloc(bucketedSize)
    CATCH Throwable e
        // Allocation failed, revert the internal counters
        SYNCHRONIZED(this) DO
            mUsed.decrement(sizeInBytes)
            bucket = getBucket(bucketedSize)
            IF bucket IS NOT NULL THEN
                bucket.decrementInUseCount()
            END IF
        END SYNCHRONIZED
        
        // Propagate the exception if applicable
        Throwables.propagateIfPossible(e)
    END TRY

    // Update state after allocation
    SYNCHRONIZED(this) DO
        Preconditions.checkState(mInUseValues.add(value))
        
        // If the pool exceeds the max size, attempt to trim it
        trimToSoftCap()
        mPoolStatsTracker.onAlloc(sizeInBytes)
        logStats()
        
        // Log verbose information about the allocated value
        IF FLog.isLoggable(FLog.VERBOSE) THEN
            FLog.v(TAG, "get (alloc) (object, size) = (%x, %s)", System.identityHashCode(value), bucketedSize)
        END IF
    END SYNCHRONIZED

    // Return the newly allocated value
    RETURN value
END FUNCTION
```

Schedules a new transfer to download data from Amazon S3 using presigned url and save it to the specified file. This method is non-blocking and returns immediately (i.e. before the data has been fully downloaded).

Use the returned {@link PresignedUrlDownload} object to query the progress of the transfer, add listeners for progress events, and wait for the download to complete.

Note: The result of the operation doesn't support pause and resume functionality.

@param request The request containing all the parameters for the download. @param destFile The file to download the object data to. @param downloadContext Additional configuration to control the download behavior @return A new {@link PresignedUrlDownload} object to check the state of the download, listen for progress notifications, and otherwise manage the download.
pseudo_code:

```
// Function to download data from Amazon S3 using a presigned URL
FUNCTION download(request: PresignedUrlDownloadRequest, destFile: File, downloadContext: PresignedUrlDownloadConfig) 
    // Validate input parameters
    ASSERT request IS NOT NULL // Ensure valid download request is provided
    ASSERT destFile IS NOT NULL // Ensure valid destination file is provided
    ASSERT downloadContext IS NOT NULL // Ensure valid download context is provided

    // Append user agent to request
    APPEND user agent to request

    // Create transfer progress tracking
    INITIALIZE transferProgress as TransferProgress

    // Create progress listener chain
    INITIALIZE listenerChain as S3ProgressListenerChain with TransferProgressUpdatingListener(transferProgress), request.generalProgressListener, downloadContext.S3progressListener
    SET request.generalProgressListener to new ProgressListenerChain with TransferCompletionFilter, listenerChain

    // Initialize byte range variables
    SET startByte to 0
    SET endByte to NULL

    // Get the byte range from the request
    SET range to request.getRange()
    IF range IS NOT NULL AND range.length == 2 THEN
        SET startByte to range[0]
        SET endByte to range[1]
    ELSE
        // Fetch content length if range is not specified
        SET objectMetadata to getObjectMetadataUsingRange(request)
        IF objectMetadata IS NOT NULL THEN
            SET contentLength to TransferManagerUtils.getContentLengthFromContentRange(objectMetadata)
            SET endByte to contentLength IS NOT NULL ? contentLength - 1 : NULL
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

    // Determine download behavior
    SET perRequestDownloadSize to downloadContext.getDownloadSizePerRequest()
    SET isDownloadParallel to isDownloadParallel(request, startByte, endByte, perRequestDownloadSize)

    // Create download instance
    INITIALIZE download as PresignedUrlDownloadImpl with description, transferProgress, listenerChain, request

    // Set total bytes to transfer if range is specified
    IF startByte IS NOT NULL AND endByte IS NOT NULL THEN
        SET transferProgress.totalBytesToTransfer to endByte - startByte + 1
    ENDIF

    // Prepare for asynchronous download
    INITIALIZE latch as CountDownLatch with 1
    INITIALIZE future as submit download task to executorService with PresignUrlDownloadCallable

    // Set monitor for download status
    SET download.monitor to new DownloadMonitor(download, future)
    CALL latch.countDown()
    
    // Return the download object to manage the download state
    RETURN download
END FUNCTION
```
